_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): recharts wrappers — one data prop, consistent sizing. Requires recharts: npm install recharts.
name: comp-charts
description: Recharts wrappers: LineChart, BarChart, PieChart with one data prop. Requires: npm install recharts.
notes: Usage: <LineChart data={[{month, sales}]} xKey="month" yKeys={['sales']} />. Consistent 16:9 sizing, tooltip + legend included. Install recharts first.
